question: Under NERC Reliability Standard EOP-012 as in effect on 2026-03-29, when a new gas turbine enters commercial operation on 2028-01-10, and at that point its Generator Owner, while assessing freeze protection for the unit, determines that a cold weather constraint applies, the Generator Owner must submit its Generator Cold Weather Constraint declaration to the CEA within how many calendar days? Under NERC Reliability Standard PRC-024 as in effect on 2024-09-30, when during a disturbance the voltage at the high side of the step-up transformer of a generating plant in the Western Interconnection, on a 230 kV transmission system, rises to 266 kV, what is the Minimum Time (sec) in the voltage boundary data points for that voltage? answer.value: 1% of peak demand or 50 MW, whichever is greater
